notes.text: The digital text gives the complete Tyre dialogue at 2:8:11. It portrays Ḥiyya reporting to Yoḥanan and distinguishes knowing the hour from supernatural agency. Preserve Heilprin’s root locator as printed.
The digital text locates the named Mana bar Tanḥum statement in 8:3:30. The name and transmission from Ḥanina are explicit.
The first named chain is Yasa in the name of Mana. The separate Tanḥum and Abbahu chain reports Yoḥanan.
Eruvin’s HaDar has the same dictum from Yasa, here with the explicit patronymic Mana bar Tanḥum.
Distinguish the chapter HaDar in Eruvin from the ensuing separate tractate locator.
The Sukkah episode explicitly makes Mana the wedding attendant of Yaakov bar Yefaliti. Mana’s patronymic is absent there. Keep the claimed identification attributed to Heilprin.
The checked Ma’aser Sheni division does not establish this chain. The mark follows two verified parallels, which are retained as separate locators.
The witnesses attest Yasa. The equation with Rav Assi belongs to Heilprin and is left qualified.
